name: Alabama Championship 2024
information: ### Thank you for attending Alabama Championship 2024! Check out the [Alabama Champions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlabamaChampionship2024#44420-alabama-champions) tab to view the state podiums for this competition! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnBnIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7a09718d6054d5a655cef0d7fc5baea3b0c67969/al-champs-png.png) Welcome to Alabama Championship 2024, the first championship in state history! The competition is open to all, but only Alabama residents are eligible for state champion titles. See [AL Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlabamaChampionship2024#36807-al-champion-eligibility) for more info. **You must read ALL registration requirements BEFORE registering!** This competition is supported and [recognized](https://cubingusa.org/state_championships) by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).
